QF.id: III-C Prevention of Money Laundering Act_2

question.text: Under Section 4 of the PMLA, the punishment for money laundering is rigorous imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than:

answer.text: 2 years but may extend to 7 years
3 years but may extend to 7 years, and also liable to fine
5 years but may extend to 10 years
1 year but may extend to 5 years

explanation.text: The Logic: Money laundering is punishable with rigorous imprisonment for not less than 3 years, which may extend to 7 years, and the person shall also be liable to fine (NISM-Series-III-C workbook, p.160). The Trap: The 10-year ceiling on p.160 applies separately to offences specified in Paragraph 2 of Part A of the Schedule and should not be treated as the general PMLA penalty. Note: Anchor the general 3-to-7-years-plus-fine punishment on p.160, and keep the Paragraph 2 / Part A 10-year provision as a distinct exception.
